summary: BTC ~$81.5k (about -0.7% 24h), still pinned in a tight range near $81-82k. New since this morning: Switzerland's FINMA approved the country's first retail spot Bitcoin ETF on 20 Oct. The 19 Oct ETF inflow (+$527M, IBIT +$665M), the PBIT filing and Sparkassen's rollout were already counted. Analysts note a 28-day tight range and want a break above $86k for confirmation, with $80k as the line to hold. Marginally more positive than this morning.
